title: WSQ Prepare and Serve Cocktails (2 Day In-Person)
description: Learn to make classic cocktails like Mojitos, Old Fashioneds and Margaritas in this 2-day WSQ-accredited hands-on course. You'll cover spirits theory, bar techniques, glassware, and even food pairing — plus sit a written and practical assessment. SkillsFuture credits and SSG funding applicable, so it's a solid deal for anyone serious about bartending.
